first_architecture.value: Two-port Mach-Zehnder with explicit scene objects, complex fields and full energy ledger before larger networks.

spectral_scope.value: RGB are independent labelled power channels at a common simulation frequency initially, not physical wavelengths.

geometry_gate.value: Separate phase-shift and geometry-controlled tests; verify recombination and overlap before claiming geometry-driven interference.

oracle_role.value: Provisional independent reference; review and compare against a separate scene-driven engine before accepting.
